name: Runebound: Elixirs
summary: Class-bound bargain elixirs for Barony: semi-common consumables with permanent or run-permanent tradeoff effects.
description: Runebound: Elixirs is a BaronyModLoader gameplay mod for class-bound bargain elixirs: semi-common consumables that grant permanent or run-permanent tradeoff effects. Solo drops are authored to match the local player class; multiplayer drops are host-authoritative and constrained to present party classes and party-size gates. The package now requires a paired installed-binary BML hook runtime that can install the Runebound live hooks and emit live install evidence. Current live evidence is limited to the fake Barony symbol provider/live-hook path for elixir metadata, use/display hooks, stat-application hooks, and host-authoritative install reporting; it is not Steam Workshop playable evidence. Unsupported builds, missing symbols, or failed live installs must fail closed and omit the package from loaded runtime reports.

barony.notes: Runebound: Elixirs is packaged as a clean BML gameplay module backed by content/data/bml elixir data and a paired installed-binary hook runtime. Stock Barony cannot load the BML-owned dynamic data files as standalone behavior. The current live hook contract is verified only against the fake Barony symbol provider; true in-game Steam readiness remains gated on live gameplay evidence. Unsupported builds or failed hook installs fail closed.

capabilities.reason: Runtime must associate marked POTION_STRENGTH carrier items with authored elixir IDs and sidecar metadata without mutating base Barony item state.
Runtime must provide host-authoritative class-aware and party-size-aware elixir generation.
Runtime must intercept eligible elixir carrier use, apply the authored bargain, and consume the item through engine-owned inventory semantics.
Runtime must persist and restore consumed elixir effects in BML-owned sidecar state across safe save/load boundaries.
Runtime must apply only supported elixir effect opcodes to engine-owned stat, combat, resource, and diagnostic hook surfaces.
Elixir names, bargain summaries, and duplicate/stacking warnings must be visible through engine-owned name and tooltip rendering.
Hosts and clients must agree on the active Runebound: Elixirs package, runtime contract, and gameplay data schema before interacting with shared elixir items or active effect state.

runeboundElixirs.description: Host-authoritative class-bound bargain elixirs carried by marked POTION_STRENGTH items. Data files define authored elixir metadata, generation weights, party-size filters, duplicate policy, and supported effect opcodes. A paired installed-binary hook runtime must install the live Runebound hooks and report runeboundElixirs plus the elixir capabilities before the package is considered loaded. Fake-provider live installs may prove hook wiring; Steam gameplay remains unverified until separate in-game evidence exists.

native.notes: Runebound: Elixirs requires the BML installed-binary hook runtime. The native runtime installs relocation-safe live hooks for elixir use, item display/name rendering, and initial STR/DEX stat effect application under the fake Barony symbol provider, and writes a dedicated Runebound live install report. Missing required symbols or failed detour installation must fail closed with BML_RUNEBOUND_ELIXIR_LIVE_INSTALL_FAILED-style evidence and leave the package unloaded. This package does not ship a Steam-ready native binary and does not claim in-game Workshop readiness.

platforms.notes: Fake-provider/live-hook install evidence covers useItem, Item::getName, statGetSTR, and statGetDEX detours. Steam/Linux gameplay remains hidden and unverified until real in-game evidence exists.
No playable Windows runtime is claimed. Windows must fail closed until a production DLL/launcher path, build manifest, checksums, and live runtime evidence are present.

conflicts.reason: Runebound: Elixirs claims authoritative ownership of elixir item metadata and active elixir effect state for this package. Another mod that owns the same elixir/active-effect state could corrupt or fork per-player sidecar state.

checksums.notes: Checksums are generated at install time for release packages. Development packages may omit this field.

source.transparency: No source-built Barony binary is claimed by this package. Live behavior requires the paired BML installed-binary hook runtime and runtime-report evidence. Current live install evidence is fake-provider scoped and must not be advertised as Steam-ready gameplay support.

build.notes: No package-local build step. Runtime behavior is supplied by the paired installed-binary BML hook runtime; fake-provider live-hook evidence is available, while real in-game Steam gameplay evidence remains pending.

runtimeReports.notes: Runtime reports must include jml.runebound-elixirs with runeboundElixirs and every canonical elixir capability only after the paired native runtime installs the live hooks. The dedicated live install report records fake-provider/live-hook detour installation status. blockOnErrors preserves fail-closed behavior for missing symbols, unsupported builds, or failed live install attempts.
